properties.name: behavior
properties.description: To allow multiple items open at the same time or only 1 item

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Defines the display: divider (with dividing line) or card (items shown in card variant)

properties.name: initOpenIndex
properties.description: The index of items which should be open when loading the accordion

properties.name: items
properties.description: Alternative to pass in a simple representation of accordion items

properties.name: name
properties.description: Set details name for exclusive accordions

properties.name: onChange
properties.description: Informs about changes in internal state, which item is open
